below_price_filter.catalyst_detail: Red Cat reported fiscal Q3 2026 after the Nov 16 close. Revenue was $11.77M, up 22% YoY from $9.65M but roughly 71% below the ~$39.5-40.7M consensus; adjusted loss was $0.26/sh against -$0.20 expected, on a net loss of $40.45M. Management withdrew the FY2026 revenue target of $150-180M outright, citing slower-than-expected contract awards and defense-funding uncertainty. CFO Christian Morrison said the FANG FPV offering was not selected as a finalist in Drone Dominance II (Gauntlet II evaluation) and that the deliveries tied to it never materialized, which drove the shortfall. The balance sheet is not the problem: ~$243M cash, ~$127M inventory and prepaid inventory, and ~$17.1M of nine-month capex on the 155,000 sq ft Blue Ops plant in Valdosta, GA. Operationally the B-18 entered sea trials ahead of schedule, the B-39 moved to low-rate production, and a new TRICHON VTOL ISR tricopter was introduced.
below_price_filter.why: The guidance withdrawal is the mechanism, not the quarterly miss. Pulling a $150-180M full-year target with one quarter left removes the entire revenue ramp the equity was priced on, so this is a de-rating of the growth multiple rather than a one-quarter earnings reaction. The FANG non-selection in Drone Dominance II compounds it by deleting the named program catalyst, leaving holders who owned RCAT for the Army-programs story with no dated milestone to hold against. Forced-seller mechanics follow: already down >55% YTD into the print, Stocktwits sentiment flipped to extremely bearish on a 638% jump in message volume, and a sub-$3 handle pushes the name out of many funds' and screeners' eligible universes.
below_price_filter.impact: Reads structural, not as a one-day headline spike that mean-reverts. Prior-session volume was 10.4M vs 4.6M on Nov 13 — 2.3x elevated before the print — and the gap is holding a near-30% loss on real premarket prints, not a thin or one-sided quote. A withdrawn full-year guide has no same-day repair path. Sector read-through is contained, which argues idiosyncratic rather than drone-sector contagion: premarket AVAV -1.4%, RR -0.6%, KTOS -0.5%, ONDS -0.4%, RKLB +0.8%, so capital is not fleeing defense-drone broadly. A dead-cat bounce attempt off the open is likely given ~$243M cash against the collapsed market cap, but there is no basis for sustained recovery until a contract award carries a date.
below_price_filter.horizon_reasoning: The reset is structural but structurally BEARISH, so for this long-biased book the only expression is a days-long oversold bounce; there is no multi-week long thesis until a dated contract award returns, and the name sits far below its 200-SMA long-bias filter.
below_price_filter.opportunity_cost: The book is 100% cash — $100,000 equity, zero open positions — so nothing would be displaced and all three weekly new-trade slots are open. The binding constraint is the rulebook, not capacity. RCAT at $2.47 is below this routine's own $3.00 floor, sits far under its 200-SMA (the strategy's long-bias filter blocks any long outright), and has no documented BULLISH catalyst, so it fails the Confluence rule (>=2 indicators plus 1 catalyst) outright. On R:R: a sane stop beneath the gap low is ~7-10% ($2.22-2.30), which demands a ~$2.96-3.19 target to clear 2:1 — a full round-trip back above yesterday's close within days, which a withdrawn full-year guide does not support. The real cost of taking it would be burning one of three weekly slots and up to 20% of equity on a falling knife while trend-aligned watchlist names (NBIS +3.5%, BE +3.4%, CRWV +2.8% premarket) go untouched. Research only; no trade.
